prompt: A high-resolution fashion collage featuring a young woman with long, dark brown hair and sunglasses. She is wearing an oversized olive green t-shirt tucked into wide-leg blue denim jeans, accessorized with layered silver necklaces, hoop earrings, and a small brown leather shoulder bag. The focal point of the outfit is a large orange paisley silk scarf tied around her head like a babushka, with the ends trailing down her back, and another matching scarf tied around her waist as a belt. The image is divided into three sections: on the left, a full-body shot of her walking confidently across a crosswalk in a busy city street; on the top right, a close-up portrait of her adjusting her sunglasses; and on the bottom right, a rear view of her walking away, showcasing the scarf's drape. The background features blurred urban architecture with vertical signage containing Japanese characters.
